$comment: Known serious/critical axe violations, per route. docs/design/04-testing.md §Accessibility
specifies exactly this: 'zero serious/critical violations on the primary routes, with a
per-route, shrink-only allowlist under the same anti-tampering rules as golden files'.
SHRINK-ONLY IS ENFORCED, not requested. a11y.spec.ts fails when an entry matches nothing —
so a violation that gets fixed forces the entry to be deleted in the same change, and the
list cannot quietly accumulate dead exceptions that make the gate look stricter than it is.
It is equally a failure to add an entry with no issue number: an exception nobody has agreed
to is just a lowered bar.
Adding a row here is NOT the way to make a red build green. It is for a violation that is
real, understood, and whose fix is a decision someone else has to take.
IT IS EMPTY, and that is the claim: zero serious/critical on /_design, with no exceptions.
The one entry it ever held — .card-meta contrast, issue #58 — was deleted by the change that
raised the rung to soft(60), which is the shrink-only rule doing its job. A route key with an
empty list means 'scanned, nothing allowed'; a route absent from here is scanned the same way.
The named-and-reviewed exception mechanism stays, because the next one will need it.
